items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: that's when Jean Starr and Justine McKinney made all that money off of some day sweetheart.

ctx.x: When you worked at that after-arts place, at the Dreamland. Yes. What did you wear there?

Street clothes. You know, remember I told you they went on the change clothes? Yeah, that's why I was asking you. Well, Joe wore tuxedos, that band wore tuxedo early. See, later on I went down to Warwick's club, Wallace Tyler's place, and worked with King Oliver. And then later on, that's when Jean Starr and Justine McKinney made all that money off of some day sweetheart. Man, it was a shame the money we made when you think about it now. Why did you do without money? My mother. A lot of my money got lost in the…
That's the year he died. What was he doing then? He was playing.
